Agent C (efficiency/elegance/readability) confidence: Review confidence: 20% chance of a missed efficiency or readability issue worth filing; correctness was out of scope for C.
Least confident areas: the real cost of check_registry at kernel scale (not measured; the tests were not run because the review was read-only), and whether verify-trust's fallback-resource re-query happens in practice (it depends on CI config).
Would raise confidence if: someone times `git vouch query` against a migrated kernel-size registry (the tests/migrate rehearsal output) to put a number on the per-request ceiling.
